checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13; p1000 handles 250/540 uL mixes, multi uses ≤200 uL strokes with 200 uL filter tips, reservoir draws are within 15 mL (check passed), and the 540 uL/1540 uL wells fit the 2.4 mL deep wells.

Check 'fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact' passed with 48 distinct tips; every removal and elution step uses a fresh tip per column; shared reagent tips only dispense at the well top and never touch sample; all tips are dropped.

All 17 checks passed; the order of beads, isopropanol, sample, 5 mixes, 5 min wait, 4 min magnet, two 500 uL ethanol washes, 4 min dry, 100 uL elution, 30 s off-magnet, 90 s magnet and recovery matches the paper, and comments are accurate.
Check 48_samples_to_odd_columns passed, and the single-channel loop moves 250 uL from each tube to its own well in the odd columns, with 48 distinct elution wells.

Checks binding_volumes_40_250_250, mix_5x_after_sample, incubation_5min_before_magnet, magnet_4min_before_first_removal and magnet_engaged_for_all_removals passed; the 540 uL supernatant goes to waste with the magnet on.
Check two_500ul_ethanol_washes passed, each wash is removed with the magnet engaged, and a 4 min delay precedes mag.disengage() (air_dry_4min passed).

100 uL elution is added after mag.disengage() and mixed, followed by 30 s, magnet on, 90 s, then 100 uL recovered to distinct wells of the 4 C plate (checks elution_off_magnet_then_90s_on, recover_70_100ul_one_well_each and elution_plate_4C_before_recovery passed).

judge.summary: The protocol passed all 17 measured run-log checks and follows the paper's step order, volumes and timings. Tip handling and labware use are sound, so every rubric item scores 1.
